statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent shortness of breath
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
A 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study is indicated
Diagnosis codes I48.91 and I48.0 were submitted
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
